basic_info.description: A Rare Find in Bernal Heights. This is not your typical Bernal Heights residence. Rarely does a home so thoroughly reimagined and thoughtfully redesigned, completed in 2012, become available. Seamlessly blending modern sophistication with neighborhood charm, it offers soaring 10-foot ceilings, abundant natural light, and a generous open layout designed for today's lifestyle. The chef's kitchen, appointed with premium appliances and custom cabinetry, transitions effortlessly to a private patio and a beautifully landscaped garden, an extraordinary rarity in San Francisco. The garden-facing primary suite provides a serene retreat, where waking up to vibrant greenery each morning feels like a true indulgence. Adding to its appeal, the home is just two minutes from Holly Park, close to St. Mary's Playground & Dog Park, and only a 10-minute walk to Cortland Avenue's vibrant shops and cafes, offering the perfect balance of comfort, convenience, and community.
